lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/ظ/م   ʿ–ẓ–m bones, a bone, to bone
; to be or become powerful, great, grand, immense, to venerate, to measure up to; proud, arrogant.

Of this root, 6 forms occur 108 times in the Qur’an:
يُعَظِّمُ yuʿaẓẓim 2 times; يُعْظِمُ yuʿẓim 1 time; عَظِيمٌ ʿaẓım 87 times; أَعْظَمُ ʾaʿẓam 3 times; عَظْمٌ ʿaẓm 2 times and عِظام ʿiẓām 13 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
عَظِيمٌ ʿaẓım [quasi‐act. part.]

1 great

(3:179) ‏ ‏فَلَكُمْ‏ ‏أَجْرٌ‏ ‏عَظِيمٌ‏ for you there shall be a great reward

2 severe

(2:114)‏وَلَهُمْ‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏الآخِرَةِ‏ ‏عَذَابٌ‏ ‏عَظِيمٌ‏ and for them in the Hereafter there is a severe punishment

3 important, notable, respectable

entries.label: يُعَظِّمُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يُعَظِّمُ yuʿaẓẓim [imperf. of v. II trans.]

1 to venerate, to respect, to observe

(22:32)‏وَمَنْ‏ ‏يُعَظِّمْ‏ ‏شَعَائِرَ‏ ‏اللَّهِ‏ ‏ whoever honours God’s rites

2 to be in awe of, to consider too great to attempt

(22:30)‏وَمَنْ‏ ‏يُعَظِّمْ‏ ‏حُرُمَاتِ‏ ‏اللَّهِ‏ whosoever stands in awe of the inviolable ordinances and prohibitions of God.

entries.label: يُعْظِمُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يُعْظِمُ yuʿẓim [imperf. of v. IV أعْظَمَ ʾaʿẓama, trans.] to make great, to magnify

(65:5) ‏وَيُعْظِمْ‏ ‏لَهُ‏ ‏أَجْرًا and greatly increases for him the reward.
